content: What are my top spending categories this month?

Based on your November transactions, your top spending categories are: 1) Rent (₹15,000), 2) Groceries (₹7,700), 3) Shopping (₹2,500). You've spent 34% of your total expenses on rent alone. Consider reviewing your grocery spending as it's already at 128% of your ₹6,000 budget.
Can you suggest ways to reduce my grocery expenses?

Here are some suggestions to reduce grocery expenses: 1) Plan meals weekly and make a shopping list, 2) Buy in bulk for non-perishables, 3) Compare prices across stores (BigBasket vs DMart), 4) Use discount coupons and cashback offers, 5) Reduce impulse purchases by shopping after meals. Your average grocery spend is ₹3,850 per trip - try setting a ₹3,000 limit per shopping session.
Am I on track with my budget this month?

You're doing fairly well! With 10 days into November, you've spent ₹18,950 out of your total ₹65,000 income (29%). Your rent is paid, which is good. However, your groceries are at 69% of budget and entertainment at 55%. At this rate, you'll stay within budget for most categories. Keep monitoring dining and entertainment expenses.
